theorem probe_nv_yes : ∃ I : GapCVP.Comparator.Instance,
    GapCVP.Comparator.hasIntegerTarget I = true ∧
    GapCVP.Comparator.gapYES400 I = true ∧
    GapCVP.Comparator.yesLanguage (GapCVP.Comparator.encodeInstance I) = true := by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ : ∃ I : GapCVP.Comparator.Instance,
      I = ⟨1, 1, fun _ => 0, 1⟩ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hw : GapCVP.Comparator.wellFormed I = true := by
    subst hI
    unfold GapCVP.Comparator.wellFormed
    rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_, by simp⟩
    simp
  have h1 : GapCVP.Comparator.hasIntegerTarget I = true := by
    subst hI
    unfold GapCVP.Comparator.hasIntegerTarget
    rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
    intro i
    exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have h2 : GapCVP.Comparator.gapYES400 I = true := by
    unfold GapCVP.Comparator.gapYES400
    rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
    refine ⟨hw, fun _ => 0, ?_⟩
    subst hI
    simp [GapCVP.Comparator.distanceSquared]
  refine ⟨I, h1, h2, ?_⟩
  unfold GapCVP.Comparator.yesLanguage
  rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact ⟨I, rfl, h1, h2⟩
